justification: Changes which outcomes make dcp-monitor exit 1; what is checked and recorded per chapter is unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: Railway: dcp-monitor CRASHED on every run 2026-09-01..10-25. Runs 5, 7, 8, 9: one failed chapter each (northern_beaches warringah-dcp-2011-full, HEAD 503) and 16 WAF-blocked chapters.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The WAF path's comment says not counted as failure but the next line counted it; a council 5xx and an unreadable list page were real failures.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the waf_blocked and transient buckets; adds a hub_errors list.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a blocked chapter, a council 5xx or an unreadable list page is counted as a real failure
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 4 of the 5 tests fail against origin/main's r2_monitor.py; all pass after the change.

break_it.scenario: A council server stays down for weeks
break_it.what_happens: a 5xx treated as transient could hide it for ever
break_it.how: TransientFetchError bumps check_failures; 3 in a row surfaces in the digest, and the daily coverage alarm reds the chapter

break_it.scenario: A council list page breaks permanently
break_it.what_happens: no longer an exit 1, could go unseen
break_it.how: verifyops_coverage reds list_not_read_2d for that council daily and sends Telegram

break_it.scenario: A real content or database error in a chapter
break_it.what_happens: it must still make the run exit 1 and page someone
break_it.how: the one remaining results failed increment still makes exit 1

real_layer_exempt.scripts/r2_monitor.py: Counting changes only; measured on Railway by the next run's exit status (dcp-monitor not CRASHED unless a real error).

post_merge.manual_verify: Next dcp-monitor run on Railway ends EXITED, not CRASHED, while blocked chapters remain.

functions.name: run_monitor
functions.input: database connection, R2 client and run options for one full sweep
functions.output: results dict whose failed count now holds only real content, parse or database errors
functions.if_none: a blocked chapter, a council 5xx or an unreadable list page is bucketed, never counted as failed
